title: Static pixel-perfect preview is not interactive QML
symptom: Approved screenshot can be displayed at zero pixel error while interactive tabs, widgets and animation remain missing.
root_cause: The default screenshot preview and the interactive QML prototype are separate rendering paths.
resolution: Use native interactive capture plus click/drag tests, dynamic-effect evidence and real-size Wayland screenshot comparison; never count static-image MAE as QML acceptance.
prevention: Separate visual-preview and interactive-functional acceptance reports for every GUI change.
